page.notes: Old-style printed index with fleuron border; the title line and some lines are partly cut and faded at the right edge, so the title and some numbers are uncertain. Several page numbers are blurred and may be misread (e.g. "p.179.180", "p.191" partly obscured). Greek words transcribed as best read. Top of page has a decorative border and a partial title line; cut-off parts and show-through omitted. Some entries are partly illegible; Greek in the E entry is transcribed as printed in Latin-letter approximation where uncertain. Hebrew word "Hebraei" is the running head.
